name: Yonder
author: Vlad Artym
description: Yonder in the Omarchy bar: the Claude Code agents that run, wait on you or have new results, lit during a call. A click starts or ends a voice call with your agents. Needs the Yonder app: yonder.so.

barWidget.description: Your agents at a glance. Left click: call. Right click: open Yonder. Middle click: pair a phone.
